# Runa

Copyright 2026 James Nuthall.

Licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1.
Full text: https://openfontlicense.org

Runa is generated, not drawn: `runefont.py` in the repository root builds
it from the same skeletons the keyboard layouts use. Change the skeleton,
rebuild, and the font follows.

Before redistributing the TTF on its own, copy the full OFL 1.1 text into
this directory — the licence requires it to travel with the font.
